1.3|3.en: Andy's sister likes the tortoises most because they are quiet.

1.3|3.en: What does Andy's bird say when it sees people? — "Who are you!"

1.4|2.en: When can the writer use her sister's room? — When her sister goes to university.

1.4|3.en: The cousin lives in an apartment.

1.4|3.q: 表妹的房间里有一张双人床。
1.4|3.ex: 她的房间里放着一张单人床。

1.4|3.ans: 跟小朋友一起去海里游泳。

10.1|1.q: 杰克觉得自己的身材很好。

10.3|1.q: 机器人老师越来越受学生喜爱。
10.3|1.ex: 机器人老师越来越受学生喜爱。

2.1|1.q: 凯瑞觉得他的校服很难看。

3.3|1.en: What does Kerry want to do now? — Go to Duoduo's to eat cake and see the neighbours.

3.3|2.en: Shirley has a good temper now.

3.3|2.q: 晚上妈妈带"我"去做什么？
3.3|2.en: What did Mum take the writer to do that evening? — Apologise to Shirley.

3.3|3.ex: 他总是低着头玩手机，楼里的人他谁也不认识。

3.3|3.en: Why did Anan call the security guard?

3.3|3.q: 那些大孩子们住在哪里？
3.3|3.en: Where do the older kids live? — In the same building as Anan.

3.4|1.q: 多多家楼下有花、有草、有树。
3.4|1.ex: 有花、有草、有树，可漂亮了！
3.4|1.en: Below Duoduo's building there are flowers, grass and trees.

我爸爸就很啰嗦，一直说个不停。

4.1|1.en: Why was Duoduo sad this morning?

4.1|1.q: 凯瑞是外向的还是内向的？
4.1|1.en: Is Kerry outgoing or introverted? — Introverted.
